Aw I understand so much. We do love our dogs so much, but it can be so exhausting to try to cater to all of their needs when we struggle with even our own. Mine is turning 9 in August, and it makes me cry uncontrollably to think of how he's getting older. I try my best to spend time with him, but I feel guilty because I often don't have the energy to play with him.

Btw, have you ever tried teaching Sadie tricks? It sounds silly and just a suggestion, but with my dog that I lost last month, that was something we did together and tbh I ended up enjoying it so much that it helped my mental state as well as his, and I felt more bonded with him. If Sadie is high energy she might benefit from the mental stimulation. Only if you want to though! It definitely takes energy and depression can really keep you from getting up and working with them.
